detail.en-US: The observation ledger uses actual retrieval and disclosure plus one calendar day; the annual snapshot has no original-availability certificate.
detail.zh-CN: 观测账本按真实获取日与披露日的较晚者加一天确定可见时间；年度快照没有原始可得性凭证。

detail.en-US: A research-only mapped build covers 14 sealed observed vintages; continuous revision-safe coverage begins only on 2026-10-14. No mapped vintage was available at the reconstructed 2015–2025 signal dates; earlier history remains reconstructed PIT.
detail.zh-CN: 研究专用映射构建覆盖 14 期已封存观测版本；连续满足修订安全的覆盖仅从 2026-10-14 开始。重建的 2015—2025 信号日均无可用映射版本，更早历史仍属于重建 PIT。

detail.en-US: A retrospective screen reconstructs listing/delisting, ST and dated-industry states: 43,589 candidates are listed and non-ST, and 43,055 also have industry matches. The screen does not establish historical PIT availability or fully qualified controls.
detail.zh-CN: 回溯筛查重建上市/退市、ST 和带日期的行业状态：43,589 条候选处于上市且非 ST 状态，43,055 条另有行业匹配。该筛查不证明历史 PIT 可得性，也未完成控制变量核验。

detail.en-US: No predictive or portfolio experiment exists for this hypothesis.
detail.zh-CN: 此假设尚无预测或组合实验。

detail.en-US: No costed portfolio result is reported.

data_version.en-US: Aggregate retrospective eligibility screen over 59,167 annual candidates using sealed research-only PIT, reconstructed listing/ST states and dated industry intervals. No returns read.
data_version.zh-CN: 基于已封存研究专用 PIT、重建上市/ST 状态和带日期行业区间，对 59,167 条年度候选进行的回溯资格汇总筛查；没有读取收益。

missing.en-US: No candidate had an observed mapped PIT vintage at its reconstructed signal date. Deploy the archive map and collect at least 12 months of verified prospective vintages before registering a return test.
missing.zh-CN: 没有候选在其重建信号日拥有已观测映射 PIT 版本。部署归档映射并积累至少 12 个月经核验的前瞻版本后，才考虑登记收益检验。

resume_when.en-US: After original-version and historical-universe qualification, do cash-expenditure candidates add predictive information beyond industry, size, valuation and profitability on a common sample?
resume_when.zh-CN: 原始版本与历史股票池通过核验后，现金支出指标能否在共同样本上提供超出行业、规模、估值和盈利能力的预测信息？

action.en-US: Audit stored flow and payable population; build annual candidates without current-headcount backfill.
action.zh-CN: 审计已存现金流量和应付余额覆盖，构建年度候选指标，不回填当前员工人数。

acceptance.en-US: Retained hashed input audit, duplicate/conflict accounting, annual common samples and disclosure limitations; no returns read.
acceptance.zh-CN: 已保留输入哈希、重复及冲突统计、年度共同样本与披露限制，没有读取收益。

action.en-US: Qualify original financial versions, historical eligibility and dated industry/size/valuation/profitability controls.
action.zh-CN: 核验原始财报版本、历史资格及带时点的行业、规模、估值和盈利能力控制变量。

acceptance.en-US: An immutable formation panel respects actual observed availability and historical eligibility; unresolved vintage history keeps the return gate closed.
acceptance.zh-CN: 不可变形成样本须满足真实观测可见时间和历史资格，版本链未解决则不开放收益检验。

action.en-US: Aggregate reconstructed listing, ST, dated-industry and observed-PIT-at-signal coverage without reading returns.
action.zh-CN: 在不读取收益的前提下，汇总重建上市、ST、带日期行业及信号日 PIT 观测覆盖。

acceptance.en-US: Immutable aggregate-only audit with verified input hashes and an explicit no-historical-PIT finding.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留不可变汇总审计和输入哈希核验，并明确记录历史信号日无 PIT 观测。

action.en-US: Run the registered four-candidate common-sample return diagnostic after input qualification.
action.zh-CN: 输入核验通过后，运行已登记的四项候选指标共同样本收益诊断。

acceptance.en-US: Report every candidate against matched controls, annual stability and serial-dependence-aware uncertainty. Portfolio evidence needs separate cost and execution qualification.
acceptance.zh-CN: 每项指标均须对照共同控制变量，报告年度稳定性及考虑序列相关性的区间；组合证据另需成本与执行核验。

action.en-US: Review the series overview and new employee cash input audit while retaining the untested return hypothesis.
action.zh-CN: 复核系列总览及新增员工现金支出输入审计，收益假设保持未检验。

acceptance.en-US: Reviewed input coverage, annual construction and aggregate distributions; original financial versions and historical workforce remain unqualified. No predictive results were added.
acceptance.zh-CN: 已复核输入覆盖、年度指标构建和汇总分布；原始财报版本与历史人数仍未核验，没有新增预测结果。
